user.title: Find your Rhinocomfort 3
user.description: Home Assistant searches for connectable Bluetooth devices named RHINO3-*. If none are found, move closer, check Bluetooth, and press Submit to search again.

prepare.title: Check the connection
prepare.description:
Check whether the Rhinocomfort 3 is already paired via Bluetooth. No new pairing will start at this stage.

Press Submit.

pairing.title: Pair the Rhinocomfort 3
pairing.description:
The Rhinocomfort 3 is not yet paired via Bluetooth. Press Submit to start pairing.

When the blue LED lights up, press the physical button on the Rhinocomfort and wait for confirmation. No PIN is needed. Keep this window open.

recovery.title: Connection not verified
recovery.description: The device has not responded correctly yet. Choose an option below; no existing Bluetooth bonds have been deleted.

pairing_retry.title: Pair the Rhinocomfort 3
pairing_retry.description:
Attempt {attempt} was unsuccessful. Press Retry to try again.

When the blue LED lights up, press the physical button on the Rhinocomfort and wait for confirmation. No PIN is needed. Keep this window open.

progress.connecting: Checking Bluetooth connection and reading the device state…
progress.pairing: Bluetooth pairing in progress. This may take up to 60 seconds. When the blue LED lights up, press the physical button on the Rhinocomfort and wait.

error.no_devices_found: No Rhinocomfort 3 is visible. Check Bluetooth and press Submit to scan again.
error.device_not_found: The selected device is not currently visible. Try another scan.
error.unsupported_device: The device did not expose the expected GATT service.
error.invalid_response: The device returned an invalid mode response.
error.pairing_status_unavailable: Could not check local Bluetooth pairing. Ensure the device is visible and retry.
error.pairing_agent_unavailable: Could not register a temporary Bluetooth pairing agent.
error.pairing_request_failed: Bluetooth pairing failed. Retry and press the physical button when the blue LED lights.
error.pairing_not_confirmed: Bluetooth has not confirmed a complete bond.

abort.device_not_found: The device is no longer available.
